claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol and paper: Ultimate 3000 RSLCnano connected to Q Exactive
Protocol: digested with trypsin overnight at 37 C
Microbiota from pig feces; searched against pig colon MAGs plus Sus scrofa; no single organism
EVs from in vitro cultures inoculated with pooled pig fecal slurry

limitations: Which of the 4 RAW files are the control (no carbohydrate) vs 2% beta-mannan cultures is not stated in PRIDE, the paper, or the deposited Perseus .sps (only LFQ columns E1-E4); treatment is therefore 'not available' and no factor value is given although the study compares the two conditions (two biological replicates each).
Biological replicate numbers 1-4 are file-order placeholders, not a true replicate mapping.
Modifications, tolerances and dissociation not stated and no mqpar deposited (.sps is a Perseus session): set to 'not available'.

Organism is the pig gut metagenome term; organism part and cell type set to not applicable (EV fraction from a microbial community culture); environmental medium 'fecal material' describes the inoculum, geographic location not stated.
Paper says 20 ug protein/1 ug trypsin; PRIDE says 50 ug/10 ug; not encoded.
